name: nc-court-docs
description: North Carolina court documents plugin. Wake County Superior/District Courts, Mecklenburg County Superior/District Courts, county-courts roll-up, family court, and magistrate small-claims (≤ $10,000). Six subject-matter bundles: consumer-debt (NCCAA + UDTPA treble), family-law (equitable distribution + equitable support), landlord-tenant (NC RLTA, summary ejectment), personal-injury (contributory negligence — pure bar), employment (NCEEPA + NC Wage and Hour Act), and commercial-disputes (NC UCC + NCUAA). NC eCourts Odyssey e-filing. Full detail in the plugin README.
